results.title: Bury Your Gays
results.overview: Bury Your Gays follows actor Grace, who can’t understand why every role she lands ends in her untimely death - until a mysterious agent explains the ‘Bury Your Gays’ trope. Now, trapped in a genre-hopping battle for survival, Grace has one mission: do not die.

results.overview: Relive Kendrick's Super Bowl LIX Halftime Show.

results.title: Exes of Christmas Past
results.overview: An ambitious hotel manager returns to her family's B&B for Christmas to find all three of her high school exes staying there.

results.title: The Final Run
results.overview: Pierce Butler, a former Marine and long-retired marijuana smuggler, whose wife is suffering from a rare type of cancer, must return to his drug-running ways and make one Final Load in order to save his house, his company, and his wife.

results.title: Verdi: Nabucco - Arena di Verona, 2025

results.overview: After a devastating freak storm, mutant bodies and other aberrations emerge from the floodwaters. This is the footage compiled from the disaster site...

results.title: Mercato
results.overview: Mercato takes us behind the scenes of today's soccer, a global industry with interests running into billions. Driss, a player agent, has seven days to save his skin before the end of the mercato...

results.title: Confidential Informant (proof of concept)
results.overview: When a female police detective sees a conflicted woman enter a house, the detective arrests her and forces her to make a hard choice.

results.title: 14 Days (Girlfriend Intlo)
results.overview: Harsha gets trapped in his girlfriend Ahana's house with no way of escaping without being seen by her parents.

results.title: Aghathiyaa
results.overview: Things go awry when a haunted mansion is opened as a tourist attraction by Aghathiyan leading to the unraveling of the dark history behind the mansion's previous occupant.

results.title: Don't Come Here
results.overview: During an excursion, to Mallorca, Spain, two young women Jill and Vivian meet a group of European tourists at an out-of-the-way pub. A scenic tour, to a deserted beach, ends in Vivian's brutal death. Friendship turns to suspicion and terror, as the survivors work to discover the identity of the killer in their midst.

results.title: Villa Amore
results.overview: Liara goes to Italy and impulsively buys the villa where her parents met. She soon learns she is in way over her head and must ask a lawyer-turned-handyman to help her renovate.

results.title: Una sombra en el rostro de Freud
results.original_title: Una sombra en el rostro de Freud
results.overview: Documentary based on the project by Dr. Florencio Monje Gil. This production offers an in-depth look at the last years of Sigmund Freud's life, exploring biographical, emotional, and scientific aspects of his existence, addressing significant historical events of the 20th century.

results.title: Good Mourning
results.overview: Two siblings reunited to spread the ashes of their father. Will they reconnect and bond or will this pull them further apart?

results.title: Bullets And Blueberries
results.overview: The Holocaust began with the indiscriminate mass shootings by the Einsatzgruppen in the bloodlands of Eastern Europe and was perfected in the gas chambers at Auschwitz. “Bullets And Blueberries” explores the motives, methods and madness of the perpetrators, using never-before-seen images captured by the killers themselves — images that fully capture the banality of evil.

results.title: Went Up the Hill
results.overview: Jack ventures to remote New Zealand for the funeral of his estranged mother and meets her widow Jill. But his mother's spirit returns to inhabit each of their bodies, instigating a life-threatening three-way nocturnal dance.

results.title: House Mates
results.overview: Karthick and Anu fall in love, get married and buy an old flat for their own. Many strange incidents happening in that house. They found out the reason and hand over the flat to the first owner Ramesh.

results.title: Fair Rain
results.overview: As a new world government emerges from the mysterious disappearances of people worldwide, a band of resisters known as the Remnant live and die to protect a valuable asset that will bring hope to those surviving the catastrophic scenario.

results.title: Noor
results.overview: Noor is a man whose love burns brighter than reason. From the moment he meets Shiuli, she becomes the center of his world. His love is pure, but dangerously possessive. Shiuli, touched by his intensity, surrenders to it, believing that love this deep could never fade. Their marriage begins like a dream, but soon Noor’s obsession turns into a storm — his short temper, insecurities, and need for control slowly suffocate the bond they built. Shiulii’s efforts to heal him only push him deeper into darkness. When she finally leaves, Noor’s world collapses.
